name: ddgg_ssgg_nlc
engine: legacy public pipeline: Generator(...).generate(..., correlators=...); Runtime.evaluate_correlated_many / evaluate_resolved
model: MG5_aMC 3.7.0 loop_sm, restriction no_b_mass (MB = 0), aS 0.118, MT 173
convention: MadLoop/BLHA C_eps=(4pi)^eps/Gamma(1-eps); physical couplings; initial spin/colour average and final identical-particle factor included, also for spin sources and resolved entries. Values are [real, imaginary] decimal strings; Laurent coefficients are ordered finite, single pole, double pole. A directed history (bra, ket) is B^dagger K_BL L + L^dagger K_LB B. Spin vectors are literal complex four-vectors replacing the leg's wavefunction (crossing phase only).
